execution_plan_gradient_contract: detached hard plan and encoder features; independent execution residuals, geometry encoder and output norm
gradient_clipping: planner and executor parameter groups clipped independently at norm 10
rollout_policy: persistent independent GPU states; one batched endpoint prediction and optimizer update; no six-step unroll
source_reconstruction: archived full1000 config, teacher schedule and loss contract; not a byte-identical source restore
runtime_difference: current Newton labels rebuilt on original boundaries
position_interface_loss: scene-fixed witness positions plus unchanged Newton activation; no future-only translation exemption
planner_supervision: actual demonstrated endpoints for every role; persistent activation is not a fixed point
inherited_pretraining: none; final predictor initialized without predictor checkpoints

reference_warmup.sampling: one shuffled traversal of all training rows per interval
reference_warmup.plan: visible demonstrated role/contact/cell; region head remains supervised and predicted

forward_progress_contract.direction: whole task start-to-end XY; fixed through each episode
forward_progress_contract.metric: rolling increase in historical furthest root projection; reset history on physical reset

short_ablation_contract.failure_contract: raw prediction feedback while physically continuable; reset on severe penetration, zero actual contacts, or invalid state; failed output contributes loss first
short_ablation_contract.event_gate_scope: region-matched scene endpoint and persistent role validity; temporal retouch is unverified
short_ablation_contract.event_layout_tolerance: 2 heightmap cells; separate from Newton contact truth

execution_gap_objective.upper: actual pair includemargin; independent of activation flags
execution_gap_objective.lower_penalty: full-body safety only; not duplicated in intended-contact term
execution_gap_objective.missing_pair: configured margin upper approach plus finite-face guidance
execution_gap_objective.contact_truth: unchanged Newton activation/allocation and primary-face selection

parallel_rollout_contract.resample_counter: per slot; every prediction including failures; persists across reporting intervals
parallel_rollout_contract.failure_feedback: retain exact pre-prediction input and target within sampling window; rejected output still trains
parallel_rollout_contract.plan_conditioning: original full1000 teacher probability on each visible pool input; zero by interval 700 unless explicitly overridden
parallel_rollout_contract.loss_weight: one mean loss over all slots per optimizer update
parallel_rollout_contract.progress_unit: reporting intervals, not equivalent to old epochs

region_label_metadata.source: fresh actual Newton active+allocated primary-upward-face target witnesses
region_label_metadata.unknown_policy: reported and excluded from region classification supervision; never geometric fallback
region_label_metadata.sampling: fresh static query at native target q; no integration or temporal mixing

contact_regions.invalid_penetrating_normal_policy: raw audit saved; entire sample excluded from gradients and rollout; never accepted as safe
